chunks: So which of the favours of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the repeated verse 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, highlighting the overwhelming abundance of divine favors (ni'm) that render denial impossible. It underscores the theological principle that gratitude (shukr) is the natural response to creation's continuous blessings, while ingratitude signifies a fundamental disconnect from divine reality.
